text:
nora: FYI deploybot auto-pinned runtime 4.0 for model=fasttext-v2 on prod-canary after increased inference errors for quantized artifacts at 04:12 UTC. Opening thread to decide rollback vs compatibility path.

deploybot: auto-pin triggered by error-rate >0.8% on canary-prod (shard-3). Pin applied: runtime=4.0 -> 3.9 (block newer). Reason: quant deserialization mismatch for packed embeddings.

omar: quick telemetry: failures concentrated on quantized small-batch (<8) requests, p99 mem spikes. Regular float32 paths look fine.

lin: options: (A) rollback runtime to 3.9 in canary and hold; (B) repackage model artifacts to new packing and roll forward; (C) hotpatch runtime to accept old packing (risky).

nora: can we repackage fasttext-v2 quickly? How long to validate?

omar: repackage + validation on staging ~1.5h. Hotpatch estimate 3-4h plus infra restart. Rollback is fastest (~10m) and minimizes customer impact.

lin: agree rollback on canary, repack on staging, then staged unpin next change window. Also mark dedicated customers as opt-in for repack testing.

nora: @deploybot queue rollback for prod-canary only, ttl=10h, annot "quant-pack-fasttextv2". Do not touch dedicated pools.

deploybot: acknowledged. Command queued:
```
/deploy rollback runtime=4.0 -> runtime=3.9 --target prod-canary --ttl 10h --annot "quant-pack-fasttextv2"
```

deploybot: rollback started at 2812349805. Rolling back shard-3.

sre-bot: Reminder: rolling restarts may cause transient 5xxs. Run warmup traffic after rollback completes.

omar: after 2 shards rolled back, error rate fell to 0.02%. Good sign. Continuing.

deploybot: rollback complete at 2812350120. TTL expiry set to 2812353720.

lin: Omar, start repack pipeline and run embedding-consistency tests on staging. When validated, we'll schedule unpin in change window 02:00 UTC with canary->regional->global gating.

omar: on it. Will post artifacts and test results back here.

nora: I'll add a short note to release notes and inform support for customer comms. Closing immediate ops; keep updates in this thread for unpin. :white_check_mark:
